description: This file contains the implementation of a fact-checking service, including functions for updating claims, scoring sources, and orchestrating the fact-checking pipeline with source fetching, analysis, and WebSocket notifications.

classes.name: AnalysisSummary
classes.description: Schema for storing analysis summary and score of a claim.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: Schema representing a source item with reliability and stance.

methods.name: _update_claim
methods.description: Updates a claim document and optionally broadcasts a WebSocket event.

methods.name: _score_sources
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic score for a list of sources based on reliability and stance.

methods.name: process_claim
methods.description: Main pipeline function that runs the fact-checking process for a claim, including source fetching, analysis, scoring, and updating the database.
